title: Global front solutions converging to an asymptotic traveling wave in a time-fractional Amari model
summary: We study front propagation in a time-fractional Amari neural field equation with a Caputo derivative and a Heaviside firing-rate function. For a class of nonnegative even connectivity kernels and strictly decreasing $C^1$ front-like initial data, we reduce the Cauchy problem to a nonlinear Volterra equation for the threshold location. We prove the existence and uniqueness of a global front solution, determine the short-time behavior of its threshold location, and identify its asymptotic speed.
